articles.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
articles.content: It's still unknown how attackers got access to Anthropic's verified Cursor account.
articles.titleZh: Cursor后门上的Anthropic VS代码扩展近12小时
articles.contentZh: 目前尚不清楚攻击者是如何访问Anthropic已验证的Cursor帐户的。

articles.title: Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware affects most servers on planet Earth
articles.content: Critical flaw in EDK2 allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.
articles.titleZh: UEFI固件中的代码执行缺陷影响地球上的大多数服务器
articles.contentZh: EDK2中的关键缺陷允许攻击者在引导过程的早期执行代码。

articles.title: Disgraced eMudhra drops out of TLS business after using cert private key of 4
articles.content: Flubbed key signing "ceremony" allowed minting of web credentials for any site.
articles.titleZh: 丢脸的eMudhra在使用4的证书私钥后退出TLS业务
articles.contentZh: 错误的密钥签名“仪式”允许为任何站点铸造Web凭据。

articles.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
articles.content: For 3 days this month, 333 exit nodes were hacked in hopes of stealing sensitive data.
articles.titleZh: 333个Tor出口节点被劫持以拦截SSH流量并检索明文电子邮件
articles.contentZh: 本月3天， 333个出口节点被黑客入侵，希望窃取敏感数据。

articles.title: Jackery made its portable power stations even smaller
articles.content: Jackery announced a new portable power station that uses the safer and longer-lasting lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries the company first introduced in 2023. But what makes the new Explorer 100D stand out is that it's Jackery's smallest power station to date, measuring only 4.6 by 3.4 by 3.4 inches and weighing just 1.87 pounds. […]
articles.titleZh: Jackery使其便携式发电站更小
articles.contentZh: Jackery宣布推出一款新的便携式电站，该电站使用了公司于2023年首次推出的更安全、更持久的磷酸铁锂（ LFP ）电池。但让全新Explorer 100D脱颖而出的是，它是Jackery迄今为止最小的发电站，尺寸仅为4.6 x 3.4 x 3.4英寸，重量仅为1.87磅。[…]

articles.title: NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble
articles.content: Gravity is a cruel mistress, slowly dragging the famed telescope ever closer to its ultimate demise with every day. Hubble is in no immediate danger of burning up in the Earth's atmosphere, but its time will run out in the early to mid 2030s unless its orbit is boosted. So NASA is taking proposals from […]
articles.titleZh: 美国宇航局希望商业航天工业能够帮助拯救哈勃
articles.contentZh: 重力是一个残酷的情妇，每天都在慢慢地将著名的望远镜拖向最终的死亡。哈勃望远镜没有在地球大气层中燃烧的直接危险，但除非它的轨道得到提升，否则它的时间将在21世纪30年代初至中期耗尽。因此，美国宇航局正在接受来自[…]的建议
